title: Basil Pesto
desc: Basil, pine nuts and Parmesan blended with olive oil.
steps: Toast pine nuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes, shaking often; cool.
Pulse basil, garlic and cooled nuts in a food processor until finely chopped.
Stir in Parmesan, olive oil and salt; avoid overheating the basil.
Weigh out the displayed yield and reserve any extra. Refrigerate in a covered container and use within 3 days.

title: Chimichurri
desc: A sharp herb sauce for grilled food.
steps: Chop parsley and garlic finely; do not blend to a purée.
Mix with oregano, chilli flakes, vinegar and salt.
Stir in olive oil until evenly mixed.
Let stand for 15 minutes before serving; stir again so the herbs and oil are distributed.

title: Salsa Verde
desc: A green herb sauce with capers and anchovies.
steps: Finely chop parsley, basil, capers, anchovies and garlic.
Mix in mustard and red wine vinegar.
Stir in olive oil to make a loose herb sauce.
Let stand for 10 minutes, then stir and serve with cooked fish or vegetables.

title: Tzatziki
desc: Cool yoghurt sauce with cucumber and garlic.
steps: Mix grated cucumber with salt and leave in a sieve for 10 minutes.
Squeeze the cucumber firmly to remove excess water.
Mix cucumber with yoghurt, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil and dill.
Cover and chill for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Hummus
desc: Smooth chickpeas with tahini, lemon and garlic.
steps: Put drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt and cumin in a food processor.
Blend for 2 minutes, scraping down the bowl.
Add the cold water gradually and blend until smooth and creamy; stir in olive oil.
Weigh out the displayed yield and reserve any extra. Cover and refrigerate until needed.

title: Guacamole
desc: Chunky avocado dip with lime and coriander.
steps: Mash avocado with lime juice and salt, leaving some texture.
Drain excess juice from the diced tomato.
Fold in onion, tomato, jalapeño and coriander.
Serve straight away, or cover the surface directly and refrigerate for up to 1 day.

title: Salsa Roja
desc: A cooked tomato salsa with chilli.
steps: Heat a frying pan and add tomatoes, onion, jalapeño and garlic with olive oil.
Cook over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, stirring, until softened and lightly charred.
Cool briefly, then pulse with salt and lime juice to a coarse salsa.
Stir in coriander and serve warm or chilled.

title: Caramel Sauce
desc: Pourable caramel made with cream and butter.
steps: Put sugar and water in a deep saucepan. Heat gently until the sugar dissolves.
Boil without stirring until amber, about 8–12 minutes; swirl the pan carefully if needed.
Take off the heat. Slowly add cream in several additions, keeping back from the rising steam; whisk until smooth.
Stir in butter and salt. Cool until warm before serving; never taste boiling caramel.

title: Vanilla Custard
desc: A pourable vanilla custard thickened with egg yolks.
steps: Heat milk, cream and vanilla until steaming, without boiling.
Whisk yolks and sugar in a bowl. Gradually whisk in the hot milk mixture.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon and reaches 82°C; do not boil.
Strain into a clean bowl. Serve warm, or cool promptly in an ice bath and refrigerate covered.

title: Chocolate Ganache
desc: Dark chocolate and cream for glazing, filling or spreading.
steps: Put finely chopped dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl.
Heat cream until steaming and just starting to bubble at the edges.
Pour cream over chocolate and leave for 2 minutes.
Stir from the centre until smooth. Use warm for pouring or cool until spreadable.
